trailhead.label: Top station of the Resciesa funicular, above Ortisei, the board’s start

cautions: Horses and cattle graze the Brogles alp in summer: keep your distance.
Natural mountain path with roots and stones.
Plan for the last funicular down to Ortisei.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
